title: No new κ: exact multi-gate resynthesis removes 117 P104 events
body:
This package applies exact coefficient changes at several times in PR6144's full word. It removes 114 ADDs and one unread INIT/COPY/CLEAR lifetime: 22,818 events become 22,701. All 3,449 native MOVE records, public boundaries and productive targets stay identical. **The complete recursive invoice is unchanged. No new κ is claimed.**

The proof gives a finite coefficient-change formula that includes chronological feedback. The certificate gives three guarded passes. A source-bound example and a nonzero-feedback control show why a derivative relation alone is insufficient.

[Proof and package](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/tree/66f4d2d7f8269fb058c3759c019e677516891082/research/p104-common-response-resynthesis) · [Receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/66f4d2d7f8269fb058c3759c019e677516891082/research/p104-common-response-resynthesis/RESULT.json) · [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600#discussioncomment-19209322)

Validation passed:

- Registered Python 3.12 checks in normal and optimized modes: all 799 input columns, each pass, a separate transpose, frames, ownership, identical recursive profiles and semantic controls.
- Committed bytes and executable modes; official export and input coverage.
- Optimized replay with Git absent and exported sources read-only, in 4.47 seconds. All 11 exported files and their modes stayed unchanged.

Full source-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. The retained source has exact head, SHA256 and Git blob pins. Native phase, complete caller, precision, compiler, BIT and outer suites are inherited or unrun; no new runtime or theorem acceptance is claimed. [Hosted CI passes](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40805358878) at head `66f4d2d7f8269fb058c3759c019e677516891082`. The initial hosted run could not resolve the fork-only source commit. The retained-source archive format now supplies the same word, with SHA256 and Git blob checks in the verifier. Hosted replay authenticates these bytes but does not establish publication ancestry. Independent scientific review is pending. The donor's requested large κ improvement remains unmet.

Base: canonical main `3f0152a32eeebac0df11946dbd50cabe5a7f7839`. Source: PR6144 at `5ec9b6dafc1ec54e2c0ca0771e8ed032f7888417`. PR6167's newer retained-operand gain is separate and is not claimed here. The selected frontier is unchanged.

New work: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. DreamingOfClouds retains PR6144/6030/5907 credit and Claude Opus 5.5 assistance. NOTICE retains PR5827, PR5811, PR5802 and the earlier P104/native/helper/caller/compiler/BIT lineage.
